name: System Availability
definition: information about the periods of activity and non-activity of a system.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date for which the availability information is provided.

System.name: System
System.definition: System for which the system availability is provided.

ClosureInformation.name: Closure Information
ClosureInformation.definition: System availability parameters which contain closure information.

ClosurePeriod.name: Closure Period
ClosurePeriod.definition: Period for which the system is closed/not operating.
